q: Diploma or bachelor's in business administration or equivalent is preferred.
2–3 years' experience in front office or admin support roles in a corporate environment.
Fluent in English; Arabic or other language proficiency is a plus.
MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Knowledge of hospitality or customer service environments is an added advantage.
r: Welcome and assist all visitors, staff, and clients courteously and professionally.
Manage front office operations, including phone calls, emails, and reception correspondence.
Maintain meeting room schedules, book appointments, and coordinate availability.
Handle courier and document dispatch/receipt services.
Ensure reception and office common areas are organized and well-stocked.
Perform administrative duties like data entry, document filing, and maintaining records.
Assist with organizing travel arrangements, internal meetings, and company events.
Coordinate effectively with various teams to support daily office operations.
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive matters with discretion.

The Gardener is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the hotel's outdoor areas, gardens, landscaped spaces, lawns, plants, trees, and flower arrangements. The role ensures that all green areas are kept clean, healthy, attractive, and well-maintained in accordance with the hotel's standards and guest expectations.
Maintain hotel gardens, lawns, plants, trees, shrubs, and flower beds.
Perform regular watering, pruning, trimming, mowing, and weeding activities.
Plant flowers, trees, and decorative plants according to seasonal requirements.
Apply fertilizers, pesticides, and other treatments as required, following safety procedures.
Maintain irrigation systems and report any leaks, blockages, or malfunctions.
Ensure landscaped areas, pathways, and surrounding outdoor spaces are clean and free from debris.
Monitor plant health and identify signs of pests, diseases, or damage.
Maintain gardening tools, machinery, and equipment in good working condition.
Assist in landscaping projects, garden renovations, and seasonal decorations.
Coordinate with the Engineering and Housekeeping teams when required.
Follow hotel health, safety, and environmental standards.
Perform any other related duties assigned by the Supervisor or Department Head.
q: Minimum high school education is preferred.
Minimum 1–2 years of experience in gardening, landscaping, or grounds maintenance.
Previous experience in a hotel, resort, villa, or similar hospitality environment is an advantage.
Basic knowledge of horticulture, plant care, lawn maintenance, and landscaping techniques.
Knowledge of irrigation systems, watering schedules, and seasonal planting.
Ability to operate basic gardening tools and equipment, including lawn mowers, trimmers, and pruning tools.
Basic knowledge of fertilizers, pesticides, and pest control procedures.
Physically fit and capable of performing outdoor duties in different weather conditions.
Willingness to work flexible shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required.

Our Aviation team in the Middle East is experiencing significant growth and is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager/Technical Manager based in Riyadh, KSA. In this role, you support the delivery of major airport infrastructure, terminal, landside, and aviation development projects across the kingdom.

The successful candidate will provide technical and project leadership across multidisciplinary teams, ensuring the successful planning, design, coordination, and delivery of complex aviation projects from concept through detailed design and implementation. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, project management capability, stakeholder management, and commercial awareness.
r: Lead the planning, management, and technical delivery of major aviation projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives, budgets, schedules, and quality standards.
Manage multidisciplinary design teams across aviation, architecture, civil engineering, structural engineering, MEP, airport systems, and specialist disciplines.
Provide technical leadership and oversight throughout all project phases, ensuring compliance with international best practices, aviation standards, and client requirements.
Develop project execution plans, resource strategies, and delivery programmes to ensure successful project outcomes.
Coordinate design interfaces between airside, landside, terminal, cargo, and ancillary facility developments.
Drive technical reviews, design coordination workshops, value engineering studies, and risk management activities.
Monitor project performance, proactively identifying and mitigating technical, commercial, and delivery risks.
Manage project budgets, forecasting, change management processes, and commercial performance while ensuring contractual compliance.
Lead client engagement activities, acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for project stakeholders.
Support business development initiatives including proposal preparation, technical submissions, interviews, and client presentations.
Foster strong relationships with existing and prospective clients, identifying opportunities for future aviation projects and strategic growth.
Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Airport Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), PMP, or equivalent professional accreditation is highly desirable.
Experience in engineering, design, and project delivery, with substantial experience on major aviation and airport development projects.
Proven experience delivering complex airport programmes including terminals, landside infrastructure, airfield support facilities, cargo developments, and associated transportation infrastructure.
Strong understanding of airport planning, terminal design, landside infrastructure, aviation systems interfaces, and operational requirements.
Demonstrated experience leading large multidisciplinary design and project delivery teams.
Strong client-facing, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities within complex project environments.
Solid understanding of project controls, commercial management, contract administration, and risk management principles.
Experience delivering aviation projects within the GCC and Middle East region is highly preferred.
